title: Painting Techniques with Delicate Textures
content: Here's a watercolor/gouache technique that was popular in the 19th century. (Link to YouTube Video) .The method involves building up textures in at least two layers of paint with delicate brushstrokes. It contrasts drybrush strokes and wet-into-wet touches.More info about those artists I mentioned:John Henry Hill (1839-1922)Henry Roderick Newman (1843-1917)William Trost Richards (1833-1905)William Henry Hunt (1790-1864)
